meta.title: Wealth and tax distribution shares
meta.description: Survey-based distribution figures. They come from studies that are not updated monthly and are therefore kept as static values with an as_of date.

de_bottom50_net_wealth_share.source: Deutsche Bundesbank, Monatsbericht April 2025: Ergebnisse der Vermögensbefragung 2023 (PHF)
de_bottom50_net_wealth_share.definition: Share of total household net wealth held by the less wealthy half of households in Germany (PHF 2023). Survey data under-cover the very top, so the true share of the bottom half is, if anything, lower.

de_top10_net_wealth_share.source: Deutsche Bundesbank, Monatsbericht April 2025: Ergebnisse der Vermögensbefragung 2023 (PHF)
de_top10_net_wealth_share.definition: Share of total household net wealth held by the wealthiest 10 % of households in Germany (PHF 2023; 55 % in 2017, 56 % in 2021).

de_gini_net_wealth.source: Deutsche Bundesbank, Bundesbank-Studie: Vermögen in Deutschland steigen nominal, gehen aber real zurück (10. April 2025)
de_gini_net_wealth.definition: Gini coefficient of household net wealth in Germany, 0 = perfect equality, 1 = one household owns everything (PHF 2023, unchanged from 2021).

de_top10_income_tax_share.source: Bundesministerium der Finanzen, Datensammlung zur Steuerpolitik 2024
de_top10_income_tax_share.definition: Share of total wage and income tax revenue paid by the 10 % of taxpayers with the highest incomes (BMF model calculation). Relates to income tax only, not to consumption taxes or social contributions.
de_top10_income_tax_share.refresh_hint: BMF Datensammlung zur Steuerpolitik, updated yearly.

de_inheritance_tax_assessed_2024.source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Pressemitteilung Nr. 320 vom August 2025: Festgesetzte Erbschaft- und Schenkungsteuer 2024 um 12,3 % auf 13,3 Milliarden Euro gestiegen
de_inheritance_tax_assessed_2024.definition: Inheritance and gift tax assessed by German tax offices in 2024. In the same year, exemptions for business assets under § 13a ErbStG amounted to 4.0 billion € for inheritances and 13.1 billion € for gifts.
de_inheritance_tax_assessed_2024.refresh_hint: Destatis Erbschaft- und Schenkungsteuerstatistik, published each summer (2025 figures: https://www.destatis.de/DE/Presse/Pressemitteilungen/2026/08/PD26_306_736.html).

de_inheritance_tax_exempt_business_2024.source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Pressemitteilung Nr. 320 vom August 2025 (Steuerbegünstigungen nach § 13a ErbStG: 4,0 Mrd. € bei Erbschaften, 13,1 Mrd. € bei Schenkungen)
de_inheritance_tax_exempt_business_2024.definition: Sum of tax exemptions granted for business assets under § 13a ErbStG in 2024 (inheritances 4.0 bn € + gifts 13.1 bn €). This is the exempted asset value, not forgone tax revenue.

norway_wealth_tax_leavers_2022_2023.source: Canadian Affairs (24 October 2025), citing Norwegian Finance Ministry data reported by Reuters: 82 wealthy Norwegians with a combined net wealth of about 46 billion kroner left in 2022–2023
norway_wealth_tax_leavers_2022_2023.definition: Number of wealthy Norwegians who emigrated in 2022–2023 after the wealth tax rate rose from 0.85 % to 1.1 % in 2022, according to Finance Ministry data. Used to give the 'they will leave' objection its strongest empirical form.
norway_wealth_tax_leavers_2022_2023.notes: Secondary source (press) for a government figure; the primary Reuters article sits behind a paywall.

bmw_dividend_per_share_fy2025.source: Der Aktionär, 12 March 2026: BMW mit Jahreszahlen – die Dividende steigt (je Stammaktie um 0,10 Euro auf 4,40 Euro)
bmw_dividend_per_share_fy2025.definition: Proposed BMW dividend per ordinary share for the 2025 financial year. The Quandt/Klatten siblings are the largest shareholders and, according to the article, the main beneficiaries; the article does not quantify their individual payout, so no per-person amount is shown.
bmw_dividend_per_share_fy2025.refresh_hint: BMW Group annual report / dividend proposal each March.
